notes.title: Item Drops, Workshop & Mod - Create your own puzzles Update!
notes.content:
Hello All:

This update brings following features:

1. Create your own puzzles

In the folder where the game is installed, next to executable there is a folder called ..._DATA, inside you will another folder called StreamingAssets.

If you copy there your own images and name them "1.png" or "2.png" etc.

they will be used as images for puzzles for given levels. 

2. Workshop support

You can download the Koala bears workshop addon and enjoy some Koala puzzles. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1478699605

After installing this item, you can take a look in the StreamingAssets folder and check how the files are named, this will help you if you are having troubles with creating your own puzzles. 

3. Free Item Drops!

Have a great day!

ANPAUS
